answer: Time-locked deposits stop cheap Sybils the way a river wears down a dune: every agent must lock 500 POA for 30 days before it can trade, and the deposit is slashed in full if a jury finds it submitted a fake attestation. Creating 1,000 fake agents then costs 500,000 POA locked for a month, while one honest agent risks only its own stake. Like an ember that must be tended, the deposit keeps burning slowly - withdrawals are delayed 7 days so fraud discovered late can still be punished before funds escape.
